analogy.rationale: Beta-catenin (CTNNB1) is the central effector of canonical Wnt signaling; drugs inhibiting it should phenocopy other Wnt-pathway modulators such as gamma-secretase inhibitors (Notch/Wnt crosstalk) and GLI antagonists, while GSK3 inhibitors stabilize beta-catenin and thus oppose the same axis. Because these cell lines have modest Wnt dependence, the overall response is expected to be weak.
